# Synthetic ICNS fixture

`jpeg2000.icns` contains one 256 × 256 solid blue RGBA image (36, 128, 220, 255),
encoded as JPEG 2000 in an `ic08` ICNS entry. It was generated locally from
synthetic pixels using macOS `sips -s format jp2`; no application icon or
third-party artwork was copied. It exercises ICNS files without a small PNG
representation, as found in the reported Tabby application.
